instruction:
OUTPUT FORMAT INSTRUCTIONS:
Generate exactly {num_samples} samples.
Format your response as a numbered list. Each sample must be on its own line, starting with the number followed by a period and a space.
Example format:
1. [first sample]
2. [second sample]
...
{num_samples}. [last sample]

Do NOT include any preamble, explanation, or commentary. Output ONLY the numbered list.

metadata.notes: Appended to a generation prompt's system_prompt (PromptTemplate's format_style="numbered") so its paired extractor (extract_and_clean(style="numbered")) can parse the reply. Not a full chat prompt on its own — a snippet, loaded via load_prompt() for consistency with every other prompt file rather than a hardcoded Python string.
